Syntax checks, exact unified diffs, original drivers and addenda remain in the archive. The original oracle, behavioral and public contracts were unchanged.

execution.fixtureClockPurpose: Deterministic native study-note date only; it is not the actual process timestamp.

findings.detail: Valid default coupling/20 remained unapplied, with no stale output. The physical course download exactly matched the frozen deck bytes. Concepts, original attribution/license, local guide/learner links and all six readable assumptions were checked; the native disclosure was explicitly opened.

Repulsion with committed raw text ' 014 ' produced the independent 7/100,43/100,43/100,7/100 rows, phase-relative classes, native offspring, 43/50 and 7/50 totals, all=1/1 and half allele marginals. Two physical observation downloads matched the complete independent ordered JSON byte oracle, including raw spaces, reduced fractions, all assumptions, UTF-8 formatting and terminal LF.

Same-value input/change retired output; retained disabled activation exported nothing. Unannounced DOM changes refused old output. Blank, signed, decimal, exponent, 51 and 33-digit inputs refused after valid prior output; 32 zeros remained valid. An invalid cross did not affect the exact course download. Separate one-shot URL.createObjectURL failures for observation and course showed visible errors, preserved current applied state and succeeded on explicit retry. Historical downloaded bytes stayed unchanged.

Coupling and repulsion at 0 and 50 matched the independent rows, homologs, tags, marginals and independent-assortment statement. Four real Tab walks from the input reached Apply in one hop, and the post-Apply walk reached observation download in two hops via the focusable table container. Enter applied/exported. At 375px, document scroll width equaled the viewport width; the companion screenshot was preserved.

Actual same-tab learner navigation reached unchanged demo ef7. The physically downloaded deck was imported through preview/cancel/explicit start. Twelve adaptive first answers produced nine correct, with misses gl-phase-2, gl-recombination-3 and gl-evidence-1. Native review preserved every first choice/explanation. Literal markup-like reflection text remained inert, application text was preserved, and the first notes download exactly matched the unchanged native exporter.

Practice contained only the three real misses. The first retry remained wrong; pause/export/resume continued with the two remaining items and finished 2/3. First-session 9/12 answers, mastery and reflections were unchanged. Paused and completed physical notes matched the native formatter byte-for-byte. The actual 375px learner screenshot and final storage audit were retained.

observations.faultInjection: Exactly two deliberate one-shot object-URL preparation failures; no provider, network, filesystem failure or completed download was simulated.

visualReview.method: Inspected contact sheets derived only from the two retained original PNGs, at native 375px column width and sequential 1400px vertical slices. No new browser capture or product execution.
visualReview.findings: Both saved pages have legible stacked controls, headings, explanations and download actions. The companion shows phase-relative endpoint labels, readable assumptions and a visible keyboard focus outline. The learner shows 9/12 first answers separately from 2/3 practice, the review list, literal application text, attribution/license and notes action.
visualReview.narrowTableLimit: The companion table uses its own horizontal scroll region; the screenshot initially shows its left columns. Exact values for all columns were checked through the real DOM. Horizontal keyboard scrolling of every table column was not separately exercised.

evidence.memberAccounting: 81 payload members plus archive-manifest.json = 82 archive entries; every member read back and byte/hash verified. Full retained base64 ASCII hash matches the native encoded-file hash before publication.

base64Custody.method: SHA256 of full retained ASCII base64; abc calibration passed; matches independent native file hash

evidence.retained: Original public/behavioral/native freezes, original capsule, all four driver versions, unchanged oracle, all three pre-execution addenda, syntax/hash logs, ten product bodies, native consumer closure, admission, actual argv/raw process outcomes, complete receipt, ten physical downloads and two original screenshots.

limits: Qualifies this exact generated page/course/source with the installed Linux Chromium route; no Windows, mobile browser, screen-reader or browser-matrix claim.

Scientific exhaustive model checks and blind content solving belong to estate_records; author native/build checks belong to workspace_discovery. This independent browser run does not relabel those as its own.

Observed no storage writes/off-origin activity during this bounded flow; this is not a general security audit or educational-efficacy claim.
All first raw outcomes remain preserved. No product runtime or original baseline was rerun to manufacture custody.
